GenAiFunction.description: Returns a wealth client's profile overview (contact, segment, investable assets, mortgage, financial goals, financial accounts, household). Identify the client from the conversation: pass a Person Account Id when you have one (in Lightning this comes from the open record), or pass the client's name & the action resolves it. If neither is available, the card renders a "name a client" prompt rather than guessing, so ask the user which client they mean rather than asking for an Id.
